summary: Integrate the existing API-only Sage chat workspace at / while preserving backend API behavior and tests
final_report: Implemented the API-only Sage chat workspace integration. FastAPI now serves static/index.html at / through a root StaticFiles mount registered after all API routers, preserving /api routes. Moved the preview assets to static/index.html, static/style.css, and static/app.js and removed static/preview copies. Replaced fixture behavior with same-origin session bootstrap and history APIs, sessionStorage validation, real session creation/selection, persisted message rendering, fetch-based POST SSE parsing with chunk buffering, ping ignoring, meta/delta/citation/done/error handling, AbortController cancellation plus /stop, and explicit client_msg_id retry. Preserved the Sage Rosé Pine visual identity, responsive drawer, named transcript log, status/error regions, labelled composer, and one h1. README now documents the root-served UI and API architecture. Verification: node --check static/app.js passed; python -m compileall -q app passed; app import and route smoke check passed; GET / returned index.html with 200 and GET /api/health returned 200; git diff --check passed. No tests or dependencies were modified. No commit made in shared workflow.
notes: Implementation completed within the declared file set. The pre-existing README and job-log changes were reconciled in place. StaticFiles is mounted after all API routers so the root static app does not shadow /api routes. The standard UI verifier was not run; review_only records that limitation. Browser runtime against a configured model was not exercised because no model API call was required for the route smoke check.
